bootstrap_over_sources.interpretation: between-source variability: how much Theta would move if a different set of campaigns and distributors had been observed

granularity.note: Theta varied by 2% across a 200x granularity range; see strata_sweep

label_permutation.interpretation: pool all sources and reassign the lure/calibration labels at fixed group sizes; tests the distinction directly

list_size_distribution.caveat: label permutation assumes the two families are exchangeable under the null. They differ in list size; O/E normalises for list size and stratum profile, but the distributions are reported so a reader can judge the assumption.
